meta.title: Shenzhen tall buildings (completed, architectural height >= 100 m) - sourced list
meta.scope: All buildings with status "completed" and architectural height >= 100 m in the CTBUH Skyscraper Center Shenzhen data (472 rows >= 150 m, 108 rows 100-150 m). CTBUH lists only some 100-150 m buildings, so that tier is "notable", not complete.

fields.height_m: CTBUH height_architecture (to architectural top, incl. spires, not antennas)
fields.lat/lon: CTBUH latitude/longitude; empty when CTBUH has none (13 rows). Never guessed. coord_check_m = distance to the en.wikipedia list coord and/or the Wikidata P625 coord, when those exist
fields.name_zh: zh.wikipedia list name (converted to Simplified with OpenCC t2s) when the row was matched to that list, else CTBUH name_chinese, else Wikidata label. Empty when no source gives one
fields.district: first of: CTBUH address text (when it names a district), the en.wikipedia list, the zh.wikipedia list, Wikidata P131 (see district_source); disagreeing values are kept in district_conflict. Empty when no source says (no point-in-polygon was done: OSM boundaries could not be fetched)
fields.built_in_gba: true when it is the nearest tower row to a Greater Bay target (src/gba/targets.json) sits on this tower (tower target within its radius / 80 m, or same zh name within 400 m) and that key appears in a module file; or it is a second tower that the target notes say the model includes (6 cases). Every Greater Bay target key was found in a module file. Note the GBA map still shows untargeted towers as OSM extrusions (gbareal b5_buildings.py); not built here means no named model

licences.CTBUH: Skyscraper Center FAQ (https://www.skyscrapercenter.com/faq): "All information provided on the Skyscraper Center is available for public use and inclusion within research if applicable citations referencing the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH) are made." Images are NOT free. They do not offer tabular downloads. The full Terms of Use page (verticalurbanism.org/terms-of-use) returned 403 and could not be read.

meta.match_notes: en.wikipedia rows matched to CTBUH by the CTBUH id in their citation, else exact name, else unique height+year. zh.wikipedia rows matched by Chinese name, else unique height(+-0.6 m)+year+floors(+-3), else name containment; looser matches kept only for 7 hand-checked pairs.
